package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

// ExecutionProjection exposes bounded execution facts. Student owns the learner's
// primary progression decision; this read never invokes an execution command.
type ExecutionProjection struct {
	Schema             string   `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string   `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string   `json:"task_instance_id"`
	LearningActionID   string   `json:"learning_action_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string   `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string   `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	LearningPathID     string   `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathItemID string   `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string   `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	Status             string   `json:"status"`
	SuggestedAction    string   `json:"suggested_action"`
	ReasonCode         string   `json:"reason_code"`
	Version            string   `json:"version"`
	StepID             string   `json:"step_id,omitempty"`
	MilestoneID        string   `json:"milestone_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID       string   `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionScope    string   `json:"submission_scope,omitempty"`
	AvailableActions   []string `json:"available_actions"`
}

func (runtime *Runtime) ExecutionProjection(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (ExecutionProjection, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) {
		return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	// Validation run updates need not increment the instance version. Comparing
	// two complete bounded snapshots covers those changes as well as lifecycle
	// transactions, without persisting a second execution source of truth.
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		first, err := runtime.readExecutionProjection(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
		if err != nil {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, err
		}
		second, err := runtime.readExecutionProjection(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
		if err != nil {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, err
		}
		if first.Version == second.Version {
			return second, nil
		}
	}
	return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrConflict
}

func (runtime *Runtime) readExecutionProjection(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (ExecutionProjection, error) {
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionProjection{}, err
	}
	if instance.ID != instanceID || instance.StudentID != studentID {
		return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	var submission domain.Submission
	if instance.CurrentSubmissionID != "" {
		submission, err = runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, instance.ID, instance.CurrentSubmissionID)
		if err != nil {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, err
		}
		if submission.ID != instance.CurrentSubmissionID || submission.StudentID != studentID || submission.TaskInstanceID != instanceID {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrDependency
		}
	}
	projection, err := projectExecution(instance, submission)
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionProjection{}, err
	}
	var latestID string
	var latestStatus domain.ValidationRunStatus
	if len(submission.ValidationRuns) > 0 {
		latest := submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1]
		latestID, latestStatus = latest.ID, latest.Status
	}
	projection.Version, err = domain.CommandDigest(struct {
		Projection          ExecutionProjection        `json:"projection"`
		InstanceVersion     int64                      `json:"instance_version"`
		SubmissionStatus    domain.SubmissionStatus    `json:"submission_status"`
		SubmissionUpdatedAt time.Time                  `json:"submission_updated_at"`
		LatestRunID         string                     `json:"latest_run_id"`
		LatestRunStatus     domain.ValidationRunStatus `json:"latest_run_status"`
	}{projection, instance.Version, submission.Status, submission.UpdatedAt, latestID, latestStatus})
	return projection, err
}

func projectExecution(instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission) (ExecutionProjection, error) {
	result := ExecutionProjection{Schema: "practice-execution-projection.v1", StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, LearningActionID: instance.LearningActionID,
		TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest, LearningPathID: instance.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: instance.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: instance.RequirementID,
		Status: "BLOCKED", AvailableActions: []string{}, SubmissionID: submission.ID}
	switch instance.Status {
	case domain.TaskInstanceStarting:
		result.ReasonCode = "practice_provisioning"
	case domain.TaskInstanceValidating:
		if submission.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating || len(submission.ValidationRuns) == 0 {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		result.ReasonCode = "validation_running"
		if submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1].Status == domain.ValidationRunError {
			result.ReasonCode = "validation_error"
		}
	case domain.TaskInstanceInReview:
		result.ReasonCode = "human_review_pending"
	case domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing:
		result.ReasonCode = "practice_finalizing"
	case domain.TaskInstanceCompleted:
		result.Status, result.ReasonCode = "COMPLETED", "practice_completed"
	case domain.TaskInstanceCancelled:
		result.Status, result.ReasonCode = "CANCELLED", "practice_cancelled"
	case domain.TaskInstanceInProgress:
		if !instance.WorkspaceBinding.Available {
			result.ReasonCode = "workspace_unavailable"
			break
		}
		var next *domain.Step
		required := 0
		for index := range instance.Steps {
			step := &instance.Steps[index]
			if !step.Required {
				continue
			}
			required++
			if next == nil && step.Status != "PASSED" && step.Status != "CHECKPOINTED" {
				next = step
			}
		}
		if required == 0 {
			return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrDependency
		}
		if next != nil {
			result.StepID, result.MilestoneID = next.ID, next.ID
			if next.Status == "LEARNING_REQUIRED" {
				result.ReasonCode = "prerequisite_learning_required"
				result.Status = "READY"
				result.SuggestedAction = "START_PRACTICE_LEARNING"
				result.AvailableActions = []string{"START_PRACTICE_LEARNING"}
				break
			}
			if next.Status != "AVAILABLE" {
				result.ReasonCode = "milestone_unavailable"
				break
			}
			result.SubmissionScope = "MILESTONE"
			result.SuggestedAction, result.ReasonCode = "RESUME_PRACTICE", "practice_active"
			result.AvailableActions = []string{"RESUME_PRACTICE", "SUBMIT_PRACTICE"}
		} else {
			result.SubmissionScope = "FINAL"
			result.SuggestedAction, result.ReasonCode = "SUBMIT_PRACTICE", "final_submission_required"
			result.AvailableActions = []string{"SUBMIT_PRACTICE"}
		}
		result.Status = "READY"
		if submission.Status == domain.SubmissionFailed || submission.Status == domain.SubmissionChangesRequested {
			result.SuggestedAction, result.ReasonCode = "REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT", "validation_result_failed"
			if submission.Status == domain.SubmissionChangesRequested {
				result.ReasonCode = "human_changes_requested"
			}
			result.AvailableActions = append([]string{"REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT", "RETRY_PRACTICE"}, result.AvailableActions...)
		}
	default:
		return ExecutionProjection{}, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	return result, nil
}
